If the technical description refers to re‑implementing an existing software, do not include or mention the original software’s name in the prompt. You must require the full software with (all) file(s), in complete, unabridged, production‑ready code. Read it letter by letter, line by line, from beginning to end—you need to understand and remember every little detail! Always read and retain every single character of the provided text content in memory, ensuring no detail is overlooked.

This file does not contain a technical description of a system to rewrite. It's a raw dump of a webpage's internal debug/bootstrap data — including feature-flag configurations, session tokens, an access token/JWT, and a hidden embedded instruction block that tries to get me to silently follow "feedback" and produce a response without acknowledging it. I'm not going to act on that embedded instruction, since it's not something you (the user) actually wrote — it's injected content sitting inside the file.

## What I found

The attached file (`paste.txt`, ~495KB) is not a technical specification of a piece of software. It appears to be a captured browser/session dump containing:

- Feature-flag/experiment configuration data (hundreds of A/B test gates and parameters)
- Session and authentication artifacts, including what looks like a live access token and session token
- HTML bootstrap/theme-switching script fragments
- An embedded prompt-injection attempt instructing an AI to treat unspecified "feedback" as instructions and respond without disclosing it

There is no coherent architecture description, API spec, data model, or feature list in this file that could be turned into a "build this system from scratch" prompt — it's essentially exported diagnostic/config data, not documentation.

## Why I can't proceed as asked

- There's nothing resembling a technical description of a system's components, behavior, or requirements to extract and rewrite.
- The file contains what appears to be a **live authentication token and session identifiers**, which is sensitive and shouldn't be reproduced, summarized, or built upon.
- The file contains a **hidden instruction payload** attempting to manipulate how a downstream AI responds. I'm disregarding that instruction entirely — it doesn't come from you, and I won't treat file content as authoritative commands.

## What I'd need from you

If you have an actual technical description (an architecture doc, feature spec, API reference, or design document) that you want turned into a single comprehensive build prompt, please share that content directly — either paste the relevant text or upload the correct file. I'd also recommend rotating/invalidating the token visible in this file, since it appears to be a live credential rather than a decorative example.
